-- The client says: Returns whether the player has any unspent talent points in their class or spec talent trees. If hasUnspentPoints is true, the number of unspent points for at least one of the trees will be greater than zero. Hero talent points are not included by this function.
local hasUnspentPoints, numClassPoints, numSpecPoints = C_ClassTalents.HasUnspentTalentPoints()
